textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3800 (Bay Trail-I)

The TQ Mini Module TQMxE38M is an Intel Atom-based COM Express Mini module designed to provide FPGA engineers with a compact and efficient computing solution. Powered by Intel Atom E3800 processors, this module offers a range of options to meet diverse application needs, with a focus on power efficiency and reliability.

One of its key features is its flexibility through direct access to various interfaces, including Digital Display Interface (DDI), embedded DisplayPort (eDP), and USB device interfaces. This allows engineers to tailor the module's capabilities to suit specific project requirements.

In addition to its adaptability, the TQMxE38M boasts a robust design, making it suitable for deployment in rugged industrial, railway, and aviation environments. With the option for conformal coating, it can withstand challenging conditions.

Memory support includes up to 8 GB of DDR3L memory with ECC protection, ensuring data integrity. Moreover, the module operates efficiently across a wide temperature range from -40°C to +85°C, making it suitable for outdoor applications.

Overall, the TQ Mini Module TQMxE38M is a reliable, power-efficient computing solution that empowers FPGA engineers to design and deploy systems tailored to their specific project needs.

text.text:
Features

  • DDR3L Memory Support: Up to 8 GB of DDR3L memory with ECC protection for data integrity.
  • Flexible Interface Access: Direct access to various interfaces, including Digital Display Interface (DDI), embedded DisplayPort (eDP), and USB device interfaces.
  • Rugged Design: Especially robust design suitable for challenging environments in industries like railway, aviation, and ruggedized industrial settings.
  • Conformal Coating Option: Offers protective coating for enhanced durability in harsh conditions.
  • Temperature Resilience: Operates efficiently in a wide temperature range from -40°C to +85°C, making it suitable for outdoor applications.

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel Atom® E3800 (Baytrail-I)
  • E3815: 1x 1.46 GHz, 512 KB L2-Cache, 5 W
  • E3805: 2x 1.33 GHz, 1 MB L2-Cache, 3 W, without graphics
  • E3825: 2x 1.33 GHz, 1 MB L2-Cache, 6 W
  • E3826: 2x 1.46 GHz, 1 MB L2-Cache, 7 W
  • E3827: 2x 1.75 GHz, 1 MB L2-Cache, 8 W
  • E3845: 4x 1.91 GHz, 2 MB L2-Cache, 10 W
Memory
  • DDR3L: 2-8 GB
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 2x Digital Display Interface (DDI) for eDP 1.3, DP 1.1a, DVI, HDMI 1.4a or LVDS (with external converter)
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gigabit Ethernet (Intel i210)
  • USB - 1 USB 3.0 | 3x USB 2.0 | 1 USB 3.0 Device
  • Serial Ports - 2x Serial Port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 3x PCIe 2.0
  • LPC - LPC bus
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • SATA - 2x SATA 2.0
General
  • Dimensions - 84mm x 55mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Mini, type 10
  • Temperature range - Extended temperature: -40°C…+85°C
  • Power supply - 4.75 V - 20 V / 4.75 V - 20 V Standby (optional) / 3 V Battery/GoldCAP (optional)
  • Power consumption -  typ. 3 - 6 W/max. 12W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
